newsitem.title: USA: Buffets sees Q3 earnings below year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Buffets sees Q3 earnings below year-ago.

text.p: Buffets Inc said Monday it expects net earnings for the fiscal third quarter, excluding expenses and costs associated with the planner merger with HomeTown Buffet Inc, will be below the $6,715,000 net earnings it reported in the 1995 third quarter.
Buffets said it based its outlook upon a preliminary review of results for the first eight weeks of the 12-week third quarter, which will end October 9.
Buffets said soft sales have continued in the third quarter throughout much of the country, due in part of hurricanes in the East Coast and the recent Olympic Games.
The company added that, as previously reported, it expects a large percent of its new restaurants planned for fiscal 1996 will open in the fourth quarter.
It said fewer openings during the first three quarters of 1996 will negatively impact third quarter results.
